title: Line chart
description: A thick gold line is drawn from the left over three or four thin grid lines (GSAP DrawSVG), a dot lands on each of the four to eight values as the line arrives, a pale gold fill follows under it, and the very large number beside the title follows the line and ends on the last value. On a phone the number sits above the chart and the axis labels turn upright.

props.points: required, 4-8 of {label, value} from left to right (real numbers)
props.title: heading, 3-7 words
props.note: one small line under the chart: the source
props.smooth: false = straight segments (default: a smooth line that never overshoots a value)
